name: opencode-devkit
description: Audit, analyze, and optimize OpenCode configuration files

scripts.dev: concurrently -n be,fe -c blue,green "python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload" "pnpm -C frontend run dev"
scripts.typecheck: python3 -m mypy backend/app/ --strict && pnpm -C frontend run typecheck
